articles.title: Newscast - Why Has The UK Government Changed Its Approach to Israel? - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: UK imposes sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
articles.body: Today, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has told Parliament the UK would ban the import of goods from Israeli settlements in the illegally occupied West Bank. In the speech, he said the UK government "agrees" there is ethnic cleansing in areas of the West Bank, and that the Israeli government is turning a “blind eye”. Israel has responded by closing the British consulate in Jerusalem and banning 11 left-wing MPs from entering the country. How much is this a change in UK policy toward Israel? Adam and Chris discuss with BBC international editor Jeremy Bowen. Plus, a spokesperson for Prince Harry and Meghan say the couple were surprised to see a letter sent on behalf of King Charles clarifying they remained non-working royals after moving back to the UK. articles.summary: BBC's Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports from an area close to Israel's proposed site in the occupied West Bank.
articles.body:
The BBC's Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports from Ma'ale Adumim - an existing Israeli settlement in the occupied West Bank, overlooking Israel's proposed E1 site.

UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, speaking to Parliament on Tuesday, announced sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank "to deter settlement expansion" and "prevent the development of E1".

Israel has opened up tenders for the construction of some 1,200 settlement homes at the proposed site.

Miliband said he would ban the import of goods from Israel's "illegal settlements" in the West Bank. He also said "ethnic cleansing" was being carried out by "settler terrorists" and accused the Israeli government of turning a "blind eye".

articles.title: Prince George attends first day at Eton College
articles.summary: The 13 year old was dropped off at the all-boys boarding school by his parents, Prince William and Princess Catherine of Wales.
articles.body:
Prince George has officially started his first term at Eton College.

The 13-year-old, who is second in line for the British throne, was dropped off at the all-boys boarding school by his parents, the Prince of Wales and Catherine, Princess of Wales.

The future king follows in the footsteps of his father in attending the elite private school, which has taught 20 British prime ministers and where fees are around £65,000 a year.

The BBC's royal correspondent Daniela Relph explains what the prince is likely to expect at his new school.

articles.title: The Best Cervical Traction Devices to Use at Home | NBC Selected
articles.summary: I found the best cervical traction devices, aka neck stretchers, to help relieve neck pain and promote better posture.
articles.body: Poor posture, sitting for hours and the lack of an ergonomic work set-up can all lead to neck and back pain. One treatment that can help relieve pain stemming from conditions like “tech neck” is a cervical traction device, otherwise known as a neck stretcher. “Cervical traction devices work by gently pulling the head away from the neck, which increases the space between the vertebrae,” says Dr. Ken Hansraj, chief of spine surgery at Northern Medical Group. The decompression can help reduce pressure on the intervertebral discs and nerves, which means, when used correctly, these devices can increase spine flexibility and ease neck inflammation. I spoke to Hansraj and other experts to find the best cervical traction devices for alleviating chronic neck pain and rounded up their recommendations. I also addressed who should use a neck stretcher (and which type) and when to speak to a doctor for further assistance. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best cervical traction products I spoke with experts to get their input on the best products for neck traction and addressing neck pain. I included their picks and other highly-rated products based on their guidance in this list below. This small, foam-filled cushion, is ideal for stretching and relaxing the muscles in the neck. It can also help relieve neck pain by using it for just 10 minutes each day, according to the brand. The ergonomic c-shaped cushion design helps ease the cervical spine and though your neck may take a few days to adjust to the device, it doesn’t cause pain. This memory foam pillow from Brooklyn Bedding is recommended by Hansraj. Although pillows aren’t technically cervical traction devices, they still go a long way in helping people with neck pain, he says. “These pillows support proper neck alignment during sleep, which can help prevent and alleviate neck pain,” he says. “They’re a good choice for those looking to maintain cervical health passively and are particularly beneficial for people with posture-related neck issues.” This particular pillow is made from memory foam, which evenly supports weight distribution and conforms to your body’s movements, according to the brand. Plus, you can choose from either a low or high profile for the pillow, depending on the height that works best for you. This pillow helps emphasize the curvature of the back of the neck and supports cervical traction. Its form allows you to adjust the height by turning it around, depending on what it is most comfortable. It has an area for placing your arms and even an area that makes positioning more comfortable for side sleepers. It also has a breathable and removable mesh pillowcase that’s also machine washable. Hansraj also recommends this cervical pillow to provide relief to the cervical spine. Its ergonomic design makes it a good fit for side, back, and stomach sleepers, according to the brand. The rectangular memory foam pillow has a groove in the middle that gently holds the back or side of the neck as you sleep. The pillow is also made from breathable memory foam, promoting air circulation, which is great for those who tend to get very hot when they sleep. This posture pump is a good option for people who need help getting rid of neck pain and increasing their flexibility, according to the brand. It emphasizes and supports the natural curvature of the neck and cervical spine by preventing discs from bulging, according to AllSett Health. It also improves posture by correcting the placement of your head, which can help people who have a “hump” behind their neck, according to the brand. How I picked the best cervical traction devices Here are the expert-recommended features I kept in mind while curating this list: Modifiability: Hansraj recommends using a cervical traction device with some degree of adjustability. In other words, it’s better to use a device that you can tune to your needs. You don’t want a cervical traction cushion that’s too high or too short for your body. Many of the devices below are available in different lofts and levels of firmness, or are adjustable based on their level of intensity of exercise. Comfort and material: Hansraj recommends prioritizing comfort and material when shopping. I looked for cushions made from ultra-soft, breathable and durable materials, such as memory foam, polyurethane foam, polyfoam and blended latex. These materials are ideal because they can conform to the structures of your neck, providing a comfortable basis of device engagement to the neck and head. All of the pillows on this list are made of memory foam. Shape and size: The structure and size of your chosen cervical traction cushion is also crucial — you want products that form your neck into the proper shape, according to Hansraj. “A design that matches the C-shaped lordosis curvature of the neck while supporting the head can enhance personal comfort,” he says. Lordosis refers to the natural curvature of the spine and is what you want to emphasize during the traction process. All of the pillows below either have this curvature or are made of a material that conforms to the back of the neck. How to shop for cervical traction devices The type of device you choose should depend on chiropractic or medical advice, according to Allen Conrad, a chiropractor at Montgomery County Chiropractic Center. With that said, here is more information on types of popular cervical traction devices you may see available online or in stores and how to know which one may best suit you: Cervical pillows and cushions: As Hansraj mentioned above, cervical neck pillows aren’t technically traction devices, but they help provide support to cervical spine alignment in a more subtle way while you sleep. These are best for people who have mild neck pain or stiffness, rather than pain related to an injury since using one can make an injury worse, according to Conrad. Look for pillows made from memory foam since they more easily conform to the shape of your head and neck, and provide more support than non-memory foam cushions. Inflatable devices: These use cushioning and air to provide support and traction to the neck; they come with a tube and inflation valve that you pump with your hand to inflate the cushion to different levels of firmness. Hansraj recommends these since they’re easy to adjust based on personal preference. They are often best for people with neck pain or stiffness that is related to some sort of injury, such as whiplash, since they can help stretch and decompress the spine at one level, according to Conrad. These are also a good option for those who don’t have dexterity issues.Posture pumps: These types of cervical traction devices help promote proper posture and alleviate pain from degenerative disc diseases. These require lying down on the floor and using a hand pump carefully to provide traction, so they’re more involved compared to a pillow or an inflatable option. With that said, these, similar to inflatables, are often best for people with neck pain or stiffness related to an injury, like bulging or herniated discs, since they help decompress the whole spine rather than one section, according to Conrad. articles.title: Radares em Aracaju: aferição provoca bloqueios no trânsito hoje | G1
articles.standfirst: Procedimento será feito a partir das 23h desta terça-feira (8) em três pontos da cidade.
articles.summary: Radares em Aracaju passam por aferição do Inmetro a partir das 23h desta terça-feira (8), com interdições temporárias em três cruzamentos importantes da capital.
articles.body:
A partir das 23h desta terça-feira (8), haverá aferição obrigatória do Inmetro nos equipamentos de fiscalização eletrônica de velocidade em três pontos de Aracaju . Para isso, o trânsito será bloqueado temporariamente.

Segundo a Superintendência Municipal de Transportes e Trânsito (SMTT), o primeiro ponto de aferição será na avenida Beira Mar, no cruzamento com a Av. Murilo Dantas, sentido Centro. Como alternativa, os condutores deverão acessar a avenida José Carlos Silva. Já quem estiver na avenida Governador Paulo Barreto de Menezes deverá acessar a rua Leovegildo Martins Fontes, depois a avenida Capitão Joaquim Martins Fontes e, então, retornar à avenida Murilo Dantas.

A segunda aferição ocorrerá na avenida Francisco Porto, no cruzamento com a avenida Pedro Paes Azevedo, sentido avenida Hermes Fontes. Os condutores poderão utilizar a rua Francisco Portugal, acessar a rua José Faro Rollemberg e seguir até a avenida Pedro Paes Azevedo. Para quem estiver na avenida Pedro Paes Azevedo, no sentido norte, a orientação é acessar a avenida Francisco Porto, fazer o laço de quadra pela rua Professor Passos Cabral e retornar à avenida Pedro Valadares.

O terceiro ponto será na avenida José da Silva Ribeiro Filho, no cruzamento com a rua Acre, sentido Huse . Quem estiver na avenida José da Silva Ribeiro Filho poderá acessar as ruas Sergipe, Rondônia e Paraíba para voltar à avenida José da Silva Ribeiro Filho. Já os condutores que estiverem na rua Acre, no sentido norte, deverão acessar a rua Amapá, entrar na rua Sergipe, rua Rondônia e rua Acre.

Ainda segundo a SMTT, os bloqueios serão temporários e ocorrerão de acordo com o andamento dos serviços em cada ponto.

articles.title: Decoração rústica em apartamento: três peças de ferro que bastam | G1
articles.standfirst: Não é preciso reformar para trazer o rústico ao apê. Três peças de ferro fundido bem escolhidas dão o tom sem pesar o ambiente nem brigar com o moderno
articles.summary: Não é preciso reformar para trazer o rústico ao apê. Três peças de ferro fundido bem escolhidas dão o tom sem pesar o ambiente nem brigar com o moderno
articles.body:
Trazer a decoração rústica para o apartamento assusta quem imagina madeira de demolição e reforma. Não precisa. Três peças de ferro fundido, bem escolhidas e bem posicionadas, dão o tom rústico sem pesar o ambiente e sem brigar com os móveis modernos que já estão lá. O segredo é o contraste pontual, não a mudança total.

Peças de decoração rústica em ferro fundido: detalhes que dão o tom sem reforma — Foto: Divulgação / Panela de Ferro Fundido

Uma peça de parede: capacho, chave decorativa ou cantoneira em ferro criam ponto de interesse sem ocupar chão.

Um objeto funcional com alma: tripé de sapateiro, suporte ou luminária de ferro unem uso e estética.

Um detalhe de entrada: capacho ou caixa de correio em ferro fundido dão as boas-vindas com o tom rústico.

Em apartamento, o rústico ganha força pelo contraste : uma peça de ferro escura e texturizada se destaca justamente por estar entre o liso e o claro do ambiente moderno. Exagerar dilui o efeito — vira tema pesado. Poucas peças bem posicionadas mantêm o ambiente arejado e ainda entregam a identidade rústica que se buscava.

O rústico no apê ganha força pelo contraste pontual: uma peça de ferro se destaca entre o liso e o claro.

A curadoria certa faz o rústico caber no moderno. As peças de decoração rústica em ferro fundido vão de capachos a suportes e objetos de parede.

Sediada em Divinópolis , no Centro-Oeste de Minas, a Panela de Ferro Fundido trabalha com decoração rústica em ferro. As peças estão no catálogo de decoração rústica , com entrega para todo o Brasil.

articles.title: Problema em sistema de tráfego aéreo cancela voos no Reino Unido | G1
articles.standfirst: Os principais aeroportos do país, como Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester e Stansted estão entre os afetados por cancelamentos e atrasos.
articles.summary: Os principais aeroportos do país, como Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester e Stansted estão entre os afetados por cancelamentos e atrasos.
articles.body:
Avião da British Airways em aproximação no aeroporto de Heathrow, em Londres — Foto: Reuters

Centenas de voos de partida dos principais aeroportos britânicos sofreram interrupções nesta terça-feira (8) após a NATS, provedora de serviços de controle de tráfego aéreo, enfrentar um problema técnico.

Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester e Stansted estão entre os aeroportos afetados por cancelamentos e atrasos. Segundo a BBC, até o momento, 1.000 voos foram cancelados .

"Identificamos que o problema estava em nosso sistema de processamento de voos. Nossos engenheiros estão no local e trabalhando com urgência para retomar as operações normais o mais rápido possível", disse a NATS em comunicado.

"Os voos continuam decolando e o espaço aéreo está aberto, mas a normalização levará algum tempo."

Heathrow, o maior aeroporto do Reino Unido, informou que estava trabalhando com a NATS para solucionar o problema. Por volta das 21h30 pelo horário local (17h30 em Brasília), o aeroporto informou que estava retomando as decolagens.

O site de rastreamento de voos Flightradar24 informou nas redes sociais que as chegadas e partidas estavam sendo reguladas nos aeroportos da região de informação de voo de Londres devido ao problema.

Cerca de 100 voos foram cancelados apenas em Heathrow e 367 sofreram atrasos no principal aeroporto do Reino Unido, segundo dados da plataforma de rastreamento de voos FlightAware. Cerca de 250 voos atrasaram em Gatwick — aproximadamente 31% do total —, conforme apontaram os dados.

O Aeroporto de Edimburgo informou em uma publicação no X que o problema poderia afetar suas operações. O Aeroporto de Dublin, na Irlanda, comunicou que voos de chegada e partida também estavam sofrendo interrupções.

Outros aeroportos que relataram atrasos ou cancelamentos incluíram o Aeroporto de Luton (em Londres) e o Aeroporto de Birmingham, bem como os de Aberdeen e Glasgow. O Aeroporto de Dublin informou que alguns voos de chegada e partida sofreriam atrasos.

A British Airways informou que estava enfrentando interrupções nos voos devido ao problema.

"Isso está totalmente fora do nosso controle, e estamos em contato com nossos clientes enquanto nossas equipes trabalham para viabilizar suas viagens o mais rápido possível", disse a companhia aérea em comunicado.

A EasyJet afirmou que o problema estava causando atrasos em toda a Europa.

A Ryanair, a Wizz Air e a Virgin Atlantic não estavam imediatamente disponíveis para comentar.

Os atrasos desta terça-feira ocorrem após incidentes anteriores que causaram graves transtornos.

Em 2024, o órgão regulador da aviação britânica afirmou que a NATS precisava revisar seus planos de contingência para falhas no sistema, depois que o processamento automático de planos de voo apresentou problemas um ano antes, causando caos nos aeroportos do Reino Unido. Executivos de companhias aéreas afirmaram que o episódio custou mais de 100 milhões de libras (135,49 milhões de dólares) em reembolsos e indenizações.

Em julho do ano passado, uma falha técnica relacionada ao radar no sistema de controle de tráfego aéreo da Grã-Bretanha interrompeu voos por mais de quatro horas em grandes aeroportos de Londres e de outras localidades, incluindo Heathrow.

articles.title: Biden diz que câncer de próstata está sob controle após radioterapia | G1
articles.standfirst: Ex-presidente dos EUA afirmou que tratamento ajudou a controlar a doença. Biden disse ainda que segue escrevendo livro de memórias e fazendo 'as coisas de que gosta'.
articles.summary: Ex-presidente dos EUA afirmou que tratamento ajudou a controlar a doença. Biden disse ainda que segue escrevendo livro de memórias e fazendo 'as coisas de que gosta'.
articles.body:
O ex-presidente dos Estados Unidos Joe Biden afirmou nesta terça-feira (8) que a radioterapia feita para tratar o câncer de próstata diagnosticado no ano passado "funcionou como esperado" e que a doença foi controlada.

Em uma publicação nas redes sociais, Biden disse ainda que continua fazendo "as coisas de que gosta", entre elas terminar de escrever o livro de memórias que pretende lançar em breve.

"Sou profundamente grato aos médicos, enfermeiros e outros profissionais de saúde que ajudaram a controlar meu câncer e que continuam cuidando tão bem de mim", escreveu.

➡️ Em maio de 2025, apenas quatro meses após deixar a Presidência dos Estados Unidos, Biden revelou que havia sido diagnosticado com uma forma agressiva de câncer de próstata, que já havia se espalhado para os ossos. Meses depois, ele iniciou a radioterapia.

No mês passado, Hunter Biden, filho do ex-presidente, afirmou que o câncer havia se espalhado "para os ossos e além" e que a doença era muito dolorosa.

Na publicação desta terça, feita durante o mês de conscientização sobre o câncer de próstata nos EUA, Biden também incentivou homens a conversarem com médicos sobre exames de rastreamento.

Joe Biden pouco antes do início da Convenção do Partido Democrata, em 19 de agosto de 2024 — Foto: REUTERS/Craig Hudson

Em maio, Biden disse que o livro de memórias presidenciais, chamado "Promise Me, America" ("Prometa-me, América", em tradução livre) , será sobre "os desafios que enfrentamos como nação, sobre as decisões que tomei e por que as tomei".

O ex-presidente citou vários momentos que devem aparecer no livro, entre eles:

a invasão do Capitólio dos Estados Unidos, em 6 de janeiro de 2021, por simpatizantes de Donald Trump;

a retirada das forças norte-americanas do Afeganistão, seguida da volta do Talibã ao poder;

os motivos que o levaram a disputar a reeleição e, posteriormente, a desistir da candidatura.

Apesar dos questionamentos sobre a saúde e a idade, Biden, o presidente mais velho da história dos Estados Unidos, decidiu concorrer a um segundo mandato em 2024, aos 81 anos.

Após um desempenho ruim no debate contra Trump em junho de 2024 e uma onda de pressão dentro do Partido Democrata, Biden desistiu da disputa. Trump posteriormente derrotou a então vice-presidente Kamala Harris, que assumiu a candidatura democrata.

O livro de Biden deve ser lançado em novembro.

articles.summary: Pesquisa foi divulgada nesta terça-feira (8), encomendada pela Globo. Margem de erro é de três pontos percentuais.
articles.body:
Pesquisa Quaest divulgada nesta terça-feira (8) mostra como está a disputa pelo governo do Rio de Janeiro, com o ex-prefeito Eduardo Paes ( PSD ) 21 pontos percentuais à frente de Douglas Ruas ( PL ), o segundo colocado . O ex-governador Garotinho vem em terceiro. O levantamento foi encomendado pela Globo.

Em cenários de segundo turno, Paes também venceria Ruas e Garotinho, segundo a pesquisa.

Veja, abaixo, os resultados da pesquisa estimulada de 1º turno, em que a Quaest mostra a lista de candidatos aos eleitores entrevistados.

Eduardo Paes (PSD): 39% (eram 37% em 25 de agosto )

Garotinho ( Republicanos ): 8% (eram 7%)

Branco/nulo/não vai votar: 14% (eram 16%)

08/09 - Quaest, estimulada, para o governo do RJ — Foto: Reprodução/Quaest

A pesquisa foi contratada pela Globo. A Quaest ouviu 1.302 pessoas de 16 anos ou mais entre sexta-feira (4) e segunda-feira (7). A margem de erro é de três pontos percentuais, para mais ou para menos, e o nível de confiança é de 95%. O número de registro no TSE é RJ-04768/2026.

Para 66% dos eleitores ouvidos no levantamento, a escolha do candidato é definitiva. Outros 34% dizem que ainda podem mudar o voto até as eleições, em 4 de outubro.

Na pesquisa anterior, 58% diziam que a escolha era definitiva e 42% afirmavam que ainda poderiam mudar. Ou seja, aumentou em 8 pontos percentuais a parcela dos eleitores que considera sua decisão definitiva.

articles.title: Advogado transforma experiência em negócio de R$ 980 milhões | G1
articles.standfirst: À frente da XPCompliance, Ângelo Peccini atende mais de 800 empresas e busca novas conexões para ampliar a atuação no mercado
articles.summary: À frente da XPCompliance, Ângelo Peccini atende mais de 800 empresas e busca novas conexões para ampliar a atuação no mercado
articles.body:
Ângelo Peccini — Foto: Imagem gerada/melhorada com o uso de IA

A experiência como advogado tributarista e empresário fez Ângelo Peccini perceber uma situação comum entre empresas de diferentes segmentos. Mesmo negócios com capacidade para crescer podem enfrentar dificuldades por causa de passivos tributários, inconsistências cadastrais e falta de planejamento. A partir dessa percepção, ele decidiu transformar o conhecimento adquirido na profissão em um novo negócio. Hoje, à frente da XPCompliance, já são aproximadamente R$ 980 milhões em passivos tributários, créditos recuperáveis, benefícios econômicos e operações empresariais analisados.

A empresa, especializada em inteligência tributária e empresarial, possui mais de 300 clientes ativos em Roraima e ultrapassa 800 empresas atendidas em diferentes estados brasileiros. O trabalho envolve gestão de passivos, regularização fiscal, recuperação de créditos, planejamento tributário e reorganização empresarial.

De acordo com Ângelo, a criação da XPCompliance veio da percepção de que muitos empresários procuram ajuda quando o problema tributário já se transformou em uma autuação, execução fiscal, bloqueio judicial ou outro impedimento para o funcionamento da empresa. A proposta foi atuar também de forma preventiva, organizando informações, identificando riscos e buscando soluções dentro da legislação.

A XPCompliance começou de forma enxuta, com uma proposta especializada para lidar com situações tributárias e empresariais complexas. Segundo Ângelo, um dos primeiros desafios foi mostrar ao mercado que conformidade tributária não deveria ser vista apenas como burocracia ou custo.

“Não bastava solucionar o problema quando ele já havia se transformado em uma autuação, execução fiscal, bloqueio judicial ou impedimento para o exercício regular da atividade empresarial. Era necessário atuar de maneira preventiva e estratégica” , explicou.

De acordo com o empresário, o trabalho começa com um diagnóstico da situação tributária, financeira e operacional de cada cliente. A partir das informações levantadas, a equipe avalia as possibilidades de regularização e define estratégias de acordo com a realidade de cada negócio.

Entre os serviços oferecidos estão gestão de passivos tributários, transação tributária, revisão da capacidade de pagamento, regularização fiscal, recuperação de créditos, planejamento tributário, reorganização empresarial e prevenção de riscos.

A empresa conta com uma equipe multidisciplinar formada por profissionais como advogados e contadores. Segundo Ângelo, a integração entre diferentes áreas é importante porque os problemas tributários podem afetar outras partes da operação, como acesso ao crédito, emissão de certidões, contratos, investimentos e participação em licitações.

A tecnologia também passou a fazer parte dos processos. Ferramentas são utilizadas para organizar informações e analisar grandes volumes de dados, dando mais agilidade ao trabalho da equipe.

Uma experiência que abriu novas oportunidades

A relação de Ângelo com o Sebrae começou antes da XPCompliance. Ele participou do Agentes de Mercado quando estava à frente de outra empresa e, durante o projeto, trabalhou aspectos relacionados ao posicionamento, à comunicação e à aproximação com potenciais parceiros e clientes.

“O programa contribuiu justamente para essa transformação. Permitiu que o conhecimento técnico fosse convertido em uma proposta de valor mais clara, compreensível e conectada às necessidades reais dos empresários” , contou.

Segundo o empresário, a participação também resultou em novas conexões. Alguns contatos estabelecidos durante o projeto evoluíram para reuniões, projetos, contratos e indicações.

A experiência foi um dos motivos que levaram Ângelo a participar novamente da iniciativa, desta vez com a XPCompliance. Segundo ele, a empresa está em um momento de consolidação e expansão e busca ampliar sua presença no mercado.

“Decidi participar novamente porque já conhecia a seriedade do projeto e os resultados que ele pode proporcionar. Agora, o objetivo é aplicar esse aprendizado a uma empresa com identidade, serviços e propósito próprios” , afirmou.

Entre os próximos planos da XPCompliance estão o desenvolvimento de novas soluções tecnológicas e a formação de parcerias com profissionais de áreas como contabilidade, administração, economia e advocacia.

O valor de aproximadamente R$ 980 milhões reúne os números relacionados aos projetos acompanhados pela XPCompliance. Conforme explicou Ângelo, o montante inclui passivos tributários, créditos recuperáveis, benefícios econômicos e operações empresariais analisados pela equipe.

O valor não corresponde ao faturamento da empresa. São diferentes casos de negócios que passaram por análises para identificar possibilidades de regularização, recuperação de valores, reorganização de passivos ou outras alternativas previstas na legislação.

“Quando ajudamos uma empresa a recuperar um crédito legítimo, regularizar um passivo ou preservar recursos dentro da atividade produtiva, contribuímos para que ela possa investir, contratar, remunerar fornecedores e continuar gerando oportunidades” , disse.

A empresa também pretende ampliar o atendimento a pequenas e médias empresas. De acordo com Ângelo, esses negócios também podem utilizar planejamento e gestão tributária para organizar suas atividades e buscar soluções para diferentes situações.

“Pequenas e médias empresas também precisam ter acesso a diagnósticos qualificados, planejamento, tecnologia e instrumentos de regularização compatíveis com sua realidade” , afirmou.

O que é o Agentes de Mercado e como funciona

O projeto Agentes de Mercado, do Sebrae , foi criado para fortalecer a atuação de empresas na cadeia de negócios entre empresas, conhecida como B2B. O trabalho começa com o acompanhamento do empreendedor por um agente de mercado, que realiza um diagnóstico da capacidade de atendimento e ajuda a preparar o negócio para novas oportunidades.

De acordo com o analista do Sebrae Roraima, Raul Carvalho, essa preparação envolve adequações no portfólio, ajustes na política de preços e treinamento para apresentações comerciais mais objetivas.

Com a empresa preparada, o projeto aproxima os participantes de potenciais compradores por meio do mapeamento de empresas, agendamento de reuniões exclusivas e realização de rodadas de negócios.

“O projeto Agentes de Mercado do Sebrae é uma iniciativa prática criada para desenvolver e fortalecer a relação das empresas na cadeia de negócios B2B” , explicou Raul.

Segundo ele, entre os resultados esperados estão o aumento das conexões e do networking, além da geração de novos negócios com impacto positivo no faturamento das empresas participantes.

articles.title: Manchas de óleo voltam a atingir praias de Maceió; veja FOTOS | G1
articles.standfirst: Material foi achado em Riacho Doce e Guaxuma nesta terça (8). Análise vai apontar se há relação com o desastre ambiental de 2019.
articles.summary: Material foi achado em Riacho Doce e Guaxuma nesta terça (8). Análise vai apontar se há relação com o desastre ambiental de 2019.
articles.body:
Manchas de óleo apareceram na manhã desta terça-feira (8) em um trecho do Litoral Norte de Maceió , entre as praias de Riacho Doce e Guaxuma. Duas amostras do material foram coletadas pelo Instituto Biota e serão encaminhadas ao Instituto Brasileiro do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais Renováveis (Ibama) e à Marinha para análise. A origem da substância ainda é desconhecida.

Um funcionário do Instituto Biota que estava de folga encontrou o material enquanto caminhava pela região. O instituto também recebeu vídeos de moradores mostrando as manchas espalhadas pela faixa de areia e enviou uma equipe ao local.

O biólogo Bruno Stefani, diretor-executivo do Instituto, explicou que a análise deve ajudar a identificar a procedência do óleo e verificar, entre outras possibilidades, se o material tem relação com o derramamento que atingiu o Nordeste em 2019.

“Nossa equipe foi até o local para coletar a amostra. Coletamos duas amostras e imediatamente informamos a Marinha e o Ibama. Essas amostras serão direcionadas para essas instituições para que seja possível a análise desse óleo e identificar sua origem”, afirmou.

A Prefeitura de Maceió também foi acionada para retirar o material da praia. Segundo Stefani, a limpeza precisa ser feita por equipes devidamente protegidas para evitar que o óleo permaneça no ambiente, seja novamente levado ao mar ou entre em contato com animais.

Veja fotos de manchas de óleo que atingem praias de Maceió

Em 2019, um derramamento de óleo de origem desconhecida atingiu praias de todos os estados do Nordeste, incluindo Alagoas. As primeiras ocorrências foram registradas em agosto daquele ano e, nos meses seguintes, o material chegou também ao Espírito Santo e ao Rio de Janeiro, totalizando 11 estados afetados.

O episódio mobilizou órgãos como Ibama, Marinha e Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP). Segundo o Ibama, a origem do poluente que atingiu o litoral nordestino naquele episódio não foi determinada.

Por isso, uma das possibilidades que será avaliada a partir das amostras recolhidas nesta terça-feira é se o óleo encontrado entre Riacho Doce e Guaxuma tem características semelhantes às do material que chegou ao litoral brasileiro em 2019.

O biólogo alertou que a população não deve tocar ou tentar recolher o material sem equipamentos de proteção. É importante sempre acionar as instituições responsáveis.

Segundo o Instituto Biota, a permanência do óleo na areia pode fazer com que a substância se misture aos sedimentos e às algas e seja ingerida por animais, incluindo tartarugas marinhas.

articles.title: Senac EAD oferece cursos para diferentes etapas da formação profissional | G1
articles.standfirst: Cursos livres, técnicos, graduação, pós-graduação e extensão permitem estudar a distância, com opções de descontos e flexibilidade para diferentes perfis
articles.summary: Cursos livres, técnicos, graduação, pós-graduação e extensão permitem estudar a distância, com opções de descontos e flexibilidade para diferentes perfis
articles.body:
Cursos livres, técnicos, graduação, pós-graduação e extensão permitem estudar a distância, com opções de descontos e flexibilidade para diferentes perfis — Foto: Divulgação

Quem busca qualificação profissional, formação técnica, graduação, especialização ou atualização encontra no Senac EAD opções para diferentes momentos da trajetória profissional. Pelo portal do Senac EAD é possível conhecer cursos livres, técnicos, graduação, pós-graduação e extensão universitária, com alternativas que permitem conciliar a formação com o trabalho e outras atividades.

Os cursos livres são voltados a quem deseja ingressar no mercado de trabalho, atualizar conhecimentos ou aperfeiçoar habilidades. As formações são 100% a distância, com cargas horárias variadas e opções em áreas como Idiomas, Turismo, Beleza, Informática e Hospitalidade.

Para quem busca uma formação mais aprofundada e direcionada ao mercado, o Senac EAD oferece cursos técnicos em diferentes áreas. A modalidade permite estudar de onde e quando quiser. Em algumas formações, não há obrigatoriedade de comparecimento ao polo. A exceção fica para os cursos técnicos em Guia de Turismo e Óptica, que possuem visitas técnicas obrigatórias.

As inscrições para a oferta apresentada estão disponíveis de 24 de agosto a 21 de outubro de 2026. Entre as opções estão Técnico em Transações Imobiliárias, Design de Interiores, Administração, Contabilidade, Logística, Qualidade, Recursos Humanos, Secretariado, Marketing, Meio Ambiente, Óptica, Segurança do Trabalho, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e Guia de Turismo. Também está disponível a Especialização Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho em Meio Ambiente.

A coordenadora do Senac EAD no Acre, Marcela Vilas Boas, destaca a diversidade da oferta. “Temos uma oferta bastante diversificada, que atende desde quem está buscando uma primeira qualificação até profissionais que já possuem uma graduação e querem se especializar” , detalhou.

Na graduação, os cursos são oferecidos pelo Centro Universitário Senac, que possui nota máxima no recredenciamento institucional do Ministério da Educação (MEC). A modalidade combina aulas síncronas e assíncronas, professores, tutores, biblioteca virtual, suporte técnico e atividades extensionistas presenciais. A rede conta ainda com mais de 350 polos de apoio presencial em todo o Brasil.

Entre as opções estão Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas, Gastronomia, Gestão Pública, Logística, Gestão Comercial, Recursos Humanos, Gestão Financeira, Marketing e cursos na área de Tecnologia da Informação, como Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Banco de Dados, Redes de Computadores, Segurança Cibernética e Jogos Digitais.

Para quem já possui formação superior, o Senac EAD oferece pós-graduação pelo Centro Universitário Senac, que possui nota 5 no recredenciamento do MEC. As especializações contam com professores titulados, materiais próprios e recursos multimídia.

Entre as opções estão Docência no Ensino Superior, Gestão Escolar, Gestão Empresarial, Marketing Inteligente, Governança Tributária, Comunicação e Estratégias Digitais nas Organizações, Gestão de Big Data e Business Analytics, Gestão de Vendas e Negociação e Tecnologias na Aprendizagem.

Uma alternativa são os cursos de extensão universitária, voltados ao aperfeiçoamento e à atualização de conhecimentos. Com duração menor que uma pós-graduação, permitem complementar a formação em áreas específicas. As atividades são desenvolvidas 100% on-line, em ambiente virtual de aprendizagem.

Entre as opções estão formações em Inteligência Artificial, Gestão de Conteúdo em Mídias Sociais, História da Arte Brasileira, Economia Criativa, UX Design, Educação Corporativa, Gestão Financeira, Marketing Digital, Gestão Ambiental, Nutrição, Saúde, Segurança da Informação, Cloud Computing, Programação com Python e Transformação Digital e Inovação.

O portfólio acompanha as tendências do mercado de trabalho e oferece diferentes caminhos para o desenvolvimento profissional. A metodologia é centrada no estudante e estimula autonomia, disciplina e organização. No Ambiente Virtual de Aprendizagem, o aluno encontra conteúdos, atividades e recursos para organizar os estudos conforme sua disponibilidade.

Nos cursos livres, os materiais são autoinstrucionais, permitindo que o estudante avance de forma individualizada e conte com tutoria para esclarecer dúvidas. Na graduação e na pós-graduação, a experiência combina aulas síncronas e assíncronas, professores, tutores e recursos digitais.

Segundo Marcela Vilas Boas, a flexibilidade é um dos principais diferenciais da modalidade. “Uma das principais vantagens do Senac EAD é permitir que o aluno tenha acesso à formação profissional com mais flexibilidade, podendo organizar seus estudos de acordo com sua rotina” , explicou.

Os diplomas e certificados dos cursos a distância têm a mesma validade dos documentos correspondentes aos cursos presenciais. Nos cursos livres, os prazos para recebimento variam conforme a formação. Já os diplomas de graduação podem ter a autenticidade verificada pelo sistema de diploma digital do Senac.

A diversidade de níveis de ensino permite escolher o caminho mais adequado a cada objetivo, desde uma formação de curta duração até uma qualificação técnica, graduação, pós-graduação ou curso de extensão.

O Senac EAD também oferece diferentes possibilidades de descontos, que variam conforme a região, o curso e o perfil do estudante. Na graduação, os descontos podem chegar a 45% em cursos como Administração, Ciências Contábeis e Ciências Econômicas. Na pós-graduação, podem chegar a 28% em determinadas especializações. Egressos do Senac têm 25% de desconto, além de outras modalidades de benefícios institucionais.

articles.title: Senac pesquisa egressos para avaliar impacto dos cursos no mercado de trabalho | G1
articles.standfirst: Pesquisa Nacional de Acompanhamento dos Egressos (PNAES) vai ouvir concluintes de todo o país até outubro
articles.summary: Pesquisa Nacional de Acompanhamento dos Egressos (PNAES) vai ouvir concluintes de todo o país até outubro
articles.body:
Pesquisa Nacional de Acompanhamento dos Egressos (PNAES) vai ouvir concluintes de todo o país até outubro — Foto: Divulgação

Senac realiza até 2 de outubro a Pesquisa Nacional de Acompanhamento dos Egressos do Senac 2026 (PNAES), estudo que avalia os impactos das ações formativas do Senac na empregabilidade do aluno egresso, avaliando a absorção do mercado de trabalho, além da avaliação das empresas sobre os egressos da instituição.

A coleta dos dados é realizada por meio de questionário on-line, com envio de links por e-mail e SMS para os alunos egressos com idades entre 14 e 80 anos que tenham sido aprovados em cursos do Senac em 2025 e concluído a formação há pelo menos seis meses. Quem ainda mantém matrícula ativa na instituição também pode ser elegível, caso atenda aos demais critérios.

A analista técnica em pedagia do Senac Acre Belquiriam Alencar explicou que a PNAES é um instrumento fundamental para que o Senac compreenda o impacto real de sua atuação na vida profissional de cada aluno que passa pela instituição. “Quando um egresso responde ao questionário, ele não está apenas fornecendo dados, está contribuindo diretamente para o aprimoramento de nossos cursos”, destacou.

Na edição anterior, realizada em 2025, a pesquisa ouviu 14.626 respondentes, com taxa de resposta de 3,1% sobre uma população de pesquisa de 474.907 egressos. Os dados revelaram que 61,8% dos formados estavam ocupados, e a taxa de formalização, que considera carteira assinada, servidores públicos e contribuintes do INSS, chegou a 76,4% entre os que trabalhavam.

O levantamento também demonstrou a efetividade dos cursos para a inserção profissional. Entre os egressos que não trabalhavam ao ingressar no Senac e concluíram cursos que formam para uma ocupação, 71,7% conseguiram um emprego durante ou após a formação. No Programa de Aprendizagem, esse índice atingiu 85,9%, consolidando a modalidade como porta de entrada para o jovem no mercado formal.

A pedagoga reforçou que esses números da edição anterior reforçam a confiança que o Senac deposita na qualidade de seus cursos. “Os dados da edição anterior confirmam o que já vivenciamos no dia a dia, que é a maioria dos nossos egressos ocupados no mercado, com expressiva parcela atuando com vínculo formal. Além disso, grande parte daqueles que não trabalhavam ao entrar no Senac conseguiu uma colocação profissional durante ou após a formação”, explicou.

Os resultados da PNAES 2026 devem ser divulgados no primeiro semestre de 2027, com recortes regionais e por tipo de curso. A expectativa é que os dados forneçam subsídios para o aprimoramento contínuo das políticas de educação profissional e ajudem a ajustar a grade curricular às demandas reais do setor produtivo.

articles.title: Donald Trump shares misleading video of King Charles and fainting worker
articles.summary: The president shares a misleading video which appears to show Charles shrugging and walking away from a man who fainted during a royal visit.
articles.body:
US President Donald Trump has shared a misleading video on social media which appears to show King Charles shrugging and walking away from a man who fainted during a royal visit.

The footage, which has been edited, features in a video shared by Trump on his Truth Social platform which appears to show other world leaders being disrespectful. The video goes on to show a montage of clips where Trump is seen honouring fallen US troops, hugging veterans and shaking hands with law enforcement officers.

The clip of the King was taken from a longer video when, as Prince of Wales, he was visiting an Asda supermarket distribution centre in Bristol during the Covid pandemic in July 2020.

The full footage, which Trump did not use, showed Charles reaching out to the man as he fell before remaining close by as he received medical attention. The video posted by Trump edits out the King staying close to the worker.

Buckingham Palace said it was not something it would comment on. The White House has not responded to a request for comment.

The three-minute video was posted by the president on the US Labor Day holiday and opens with footage of French President Emmanuel Macron at the Elysee Palace as a guardsman appears to collapse behind him.

The Truth Social video also shows former President Joe Biden apparently checking his watch during a military repatriation ceremony and former President Barack Obama stepping off the Marine One helicopter and saluting US marines while holding a paper cup in his hand.

These are followed by a series of clips where Trump is seen picking up the cap of a US marine, saluting at a repatriation ceremony and comforting the families of fallen soldiers.

Captions saying "the side of Trump the media doesn't show you" and "the people's president" appear during some of the clips and the song A Thousand Years by Christina Perri plays throughout the video.

Trump has frequently spoken of his good relationship with Charles and described him as "the greatest king in my book" at the end of the King and Queen's state visit to the US in April.

articles.title: Andrew Flintoff puts £6.75 million Cheshire mansion on market, bought in 2021 from Phil Neville, 4 years after Top Gear car crash; 10,000 sq ft home features 6 bedrooms and 4 floors

articles.body: England cricket legend Andrew Flintoff has put his lavish Cheshire mansion on the market for £6.75 million, offering a glimpse into the luxury property where the former England all-rounder has lived with his family.The 48-year-old, widely known as Freddie Flintoff, purchased the property in 2021 from former Manchester United footballer Phil Neville. The mansion is now listed as a substantial four-floor family home, spanning around 10,000 square feet and featuring six bedrooms and six bathrooms.The sale comes at a significant point in Flintoff’s life. He recently stepped down as England Lions head coach after almost two years in the role and is preparing to begin his new position as head coach of Sydney Thunder in Australia's Big Bash League.Inside Andrew Flintoff’s £6.75 million Cheshire mansionAccording to the Daily Mail, the property, known as Longwood, is described in its listing as a “stunning detached family home arranged over four floors”.Its extensive facilities include three main reception rooms, a large open-plan kitchen and family room, an indoor swimming pool, gym, games room and cinema.The mansion also has a passenger lift serving all four floors, while the listing highlights a comprehensive monitored CCTV and security system.The property has been designed around both family life and entertaining, with its principal living spaces described as exceptionally well proportioned.The bespoke kitchen features integrated appliances and extensive cabinetry, making it the centrepiece of the home's everyday family and entertaining space.The leisure facilities further add to the mansion's appeal, with the indoor pool, gym, cinema and games room offering a private entertainment complex within the property.Flintoff bought the mansion from Phil NevilleFlintoff purchased the Cheshire property in 2021 from former Manchester United star Phil Neville, who subsequently moved to the United States to coach Inter Miami, the MLS club co-owned by David Beckham.Flintoff and his wife Rachael have four children - Holly, Corey, Rocky and Preston.His two sons have also followed their father into cricket. Corey Flintoff, 20, is an all-rounder for Kent, while 18-year-old Rocky has represented Lancashire, Flintoff's former county.Andrew Flintoff’s career beyond cricketFlintoff remains one of England cricket's most recognisable sporting figures. Flintoff previously revealed that he barely left his home for six to eight months, except for medical appointments and surgeries.Speaking about the crash, he described the terrifying moment when the vehicle began rolling and said his experience as a cricketer helped him make a split-second decision that he believes saved his life.Flintoff returns to cricket with Sydney ThunderFlintoff has since gradually returned to cricket, taking on coaching and mentoring roles.He became England Lions head coach in September 2024, helping develop the next generation of English players. The England and Wales Cricket Board confirmed in August that he had stepped down from the position.His next major assignment will be in Australia, where he has been appointed Sydney Thunder head coach. articles.title: New law to force tech firms to prevent children from taking nude images
articles.summary: The government said it will legislate "as soon as they can" but may "reassess" its plans if firms make the desired changes sooner.
articles.body:
The government has said it will introduce a new law to force tech firms to prevent children from taking or sharing nude images on mobile devices.

Apple and Google, which develop the operating systems of most smartphones used in the UK, were given three months in June to block access to nude images on smartphones and other devices used by under-18s.

But culture secretary Lisa Nandy MP told MPs on Tuesday that despite "significant commitments" from both companies, current proposals "do not meet the scale of this crisis".

She said ministers would look to legislate "as soon as they can" - with the caveat it may reassess these if firms develop and implement solutions sooner.

Alongside making tech firms block nudity on devices used by children at device-level, the government said its draft legislation would also make providers of apps used by children introduce similar blocks on nude imagery.

"This will ensure that the whole ecosystem changes, tackling the means by which children are most often abused or groomed in the online world," Nandy said.

She told MPs that Apple and Google had already made "meaningful changes" to block nudity on smartphones used by children at the core of their systems, but more action was needed.

An Apple spokesperson said it launched its Communication Safety feature in 2021 to help stop children from seeing or sharing imagery containing nudity - and had since "continued to expand its capabilities".

"We share the UK's commitment to combating exploitation and abuse online, and have shared with UK officials future plans to strengthen Communication Safety and other tools even further to help keep kids safe," they said.

A Google spokesperson told the BBC it was an "industry leader in combating non-consensual intimate imagery and advancing child safety across our products".

They added Google was pleased to have "made progress" and remained committed to working on efforts to keep children safe online.

The government proposals have been welcomed by organisations and charities calling for tougher measures and technical solutions to stop children from not just seeing, but also capturing and sharing nudity on smartphones.

Ofcom data suggests that a growing proportion of younger children in the UK own a smartphone - and that the number of those do increases with age.

According to children's charity the NSPCC, content filmed on a child's device can be the starting point for grooming, sexual extortion and other forms of online child sexual abuse.

UK police chiefs have previously said restricting the ability of children's devices to take or share nude images would be a key step in preventing sextortion - crimes where a child is groomed into sharing explicit images and blackmailed.

Chris Sherwood, NSPCC chief executive, said legislative plans were a "necessary move" after tech firms failed to meet the three-month deadline.

But he said "children cannot face more delays, so Government must act swiftly and ensure these measures are enshrined in law at the earliest opportunity".

Andy Burrows of the Molly Rose Foundation said while the new proposals were "fundamental to their objective", it had been "a needlessly long and torturous road" to secure them.

"Ministers will need to demonstrate they are committed to delivering robust legislation without further delay," Burrows added.

Government proposals to prevent nude images being shared taken and shared by children were originally proposed as part of the government's violence against women and girls strategy.

Its plans for a new law to enforce the measure would not prevent adults from accessing naked imagery on their device.

However, implementing solutions to block it for children may require checking whether the user of a phone, or app, is an adult or a child.

Online rights campaigners at the Open Rights Group have previously warned that implementing the change would mean "every adult would be forced through a digital ID checkpoint, and private images could be scanned by default".

The government has denied that the move would amount to surveillance.

articles.title: Four family members confirmed dead in Bahamas plane crash, relatives say
articles.summary: The bodies of four family members were recovered after a small private aircraft crashed Monday about 15 miles off the coast of the largest Bahamian island, according to relatives.
articles.body: The bodies of four family members were recovered after a small private aircraft crashed Monday about 15 miles off the coast of the largest Bahamian island, according to relatives. The Miami-bound PA-34 Piper, a five-seat plane with four people aboard, took off from Great Harbour Cay around 11:15 a.m. Monday and crash-landed near Andros Island, Bahamas police previously said. “It is with profound sadness that we confirm all four of our family members have been found deceased,” the family said in a statement Tuesday, noting that relatives “located our loved ones and had to bring them aboard their own vessels.” “We are now in communication and working with the U.S. Coast Guard to bring our loved ones home safely and with dignity,” the statement continued. The Royal Bahamas Police Force released a statement confirming “human remains were recovered and are now in police custody.” The remains were expected to be transferred to New Providence, the main commercial section of the small Caribbean nation. The family previously said the plane was piloted by 80-year-old Mario Lamar and that his 79-year-old wife, Lili Lamar, and two of their grandchildren — 28-year-old Sofia Sosa and 22-year-old Christian Sosa — were also on board. Silvia Larrieu, Lamar’s niece, told NBC News affiliate WTVJ in South Florida that her uncle had an apartment in the Bahamas and had spent “a wonderful long weekend together” with the grandchildren who were passengers on the plane and two other grandchildren. She called Lamar “a lifelong, very experienced pilot” and said the family was “departing business as usual, like he’s done his entire life.” FlightAware, a flight-tracking platform, showed the aircraft “flying into the edge of a storm” before it quickly reversed course, Larrieu told the station. Larrieu’s cousin, the mother of the two adult grandchildren on board, called authorities when she didn’t hear from her kids after they were supposed to have landed. Earlier Tuesday, the family pleaded for assistance in the search. “We are heartbroken and desperate. As of this moment, we are not aware of authorities actively searching the waters for our remaining missing family members,” the family added. “We are begging for help.” After the grim discoveries, the family members thanked “everyone who supported us, searched alongside us, and kept our family in their prayers.” Mario Lamar was an attorney for over 50 years and had a law office in Miami, according to a state database. Guilaine Sosa, his daughter and the mother of his grandchildren who died, practiced with him at the firm, public records show. Christian Sosa graduated with a marketing degree this year from Loyola Marymount University in Los Angeles and was a sports photographer who had recently done seasonal freelance work for the Los Angeles Rams, according to his LinkedIn profile. “Getting to shoot in the NFL was surreal,” Sosa said in a post that also had a portrait of the team’s photography staff. “It’s the job my younger self dreamed about when I spent summers in Miami shooting training camps as a fan.” He also maintained an Instagram account with landscape and nature shots from the Grand Canyon and other national parks. Matt Stefl, one of Sosa’s professors at Loyola, praised the young man and told NBC News he was “absolutely gutted” by the news. “The world lost a good one,” he said. Stefl visited the United Nations in May with Sosa and other students for a collegiate program where the group pitched a marketing campaign. The educator remained in touch with Sosa throughout the summer “about career prospects and life in general.” “Christian was an amazing young man who lit up every room that he walked into,” Stefl said. Sofia Sosa graduated from Florida International University with a master’s degree in physician assistant studies in December 2023, according to a school spokesperson. Her Facebook profile had her listed as a student at the FIU Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine in 2021. Her page, which shows the nickname “Sofi,” had not been updated since 2023 but included photos of her throughout the years enjoying life from tropical settings. She also promoted a fundraiser for a childhood cancer charity.

articles.title: 5.3-magnitude quake hits Tibet as region reels from deadly flash floods
articles.summary: China News: An earthquake of magnitude 5.3 struck Tibet on Tuesday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said, with the quake occurring at a dep.
articles.body: An earthquake of magnitude 5.3 struck Tibet on Tuesday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said, with the quake occurring at a depth of 35 km (21.75 miles).The earthquake comes days after another tremor struck the region. An earthquake of magnitude 5 was reported in Tibet on last week’s Thursday, according to the German Research Centre for Geosciences (GFZ).That quake occurred at a depth of 10 km (6.21 miles), according to the data.The latest earthquake was deeper than the tremor reported five days earlier, based on the respective seismic data.Tibet faces growing scrutiny after deadly flash floodsThe latest earthquake also comes as Tibet remains under scrutiny following a devastating flash flood that struck the Tibet-Nepal border on August 26.The disaster was triggered by an ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border, sending a massive surge of water and debris downstream through the Bhotekoshi River. The floods devastated settlements in northern and central Nepal and damaged hydropower projects.The disaster has also raised concerns over the fragile environment of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Chinese climate experts said rising temperatures, accelerated glacier melt and retreat, local geological and geomorphological conditions and broader climatic influences may have contributed to the disaster.Sun Xiaoguang, head of the Meteorological Observatory of the Tibet Autonomous Region, said: “According to our monitoring, we can see the short-time rain days, or the imbalance of the rain pattern and the rising of the temperature in Tibet.”He also said the region may be affected by the climate change crisis and that extreme weather incidents in China could become more frequent.Chinese officials said Tibet has 33,000 glaciers, including 187 categorised as high-risk and requiring round-the-clock satellite monitoring to predict possible collapses, according to PTI.Nepal flood death toll rises to 1,357The August 26 flash floods have caused extensive loss of life in Nepal. The death toll rose to 1,357 on Tuesday as more bodies were recovered from affected areas, authorities said.The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said rescue teams were continuing to search for 5,326 people, while 13,583 people had been rescued.Security forces recovered hundreds of bodies from several affected districts, including Chitawan, Nawalparasi East and West, Nuwakot, Rasuwa, Gorkha, Dhading and Tanahu. So far, 102 bodies had been handed over to family members after identification and completion of legal formalities.At least 43 people were also killed on the Chinese side, while more than 500 people remained missing in Tibet, according to Chinese media reports.The floods washed away homes, vehicles, roads and bridges and damaged hydropower projects across northern and central Nepal. Rescue operations were also underway at hydropower projects, where 121 people were believed to be trapped in underground tunnels.The disaster has also renewed scrutiny of China's hydropower projects in Tibet, including the planned mega dam on the Brahmaputra River. The region is the source of around 10 transboundary rivers, including the Brahmaputra.Chinese researchers have linked the growing risks in the region to glacier retreat and climate change.Kang Shichang, director and researcher at the Institute of Mountain Hazards and Environment under the Chinese Academy of Sciences, said glaciers across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau had shrunk by about 24% in area over the past six decades.In the southern part of the plateau, including the Himalayas, glacier area had fallen by about 40% over the same period, Kang told Chinese daily The Paper, attributing the retreat primarily to global warming.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Three arrested after woman dies in multi-vehicle crash on A8
articles.summary: Police Scotland said two women aged 23 and 19 and a man aged 32 were  arrested in connection with Monday's crash near Edinburgh Airport.
articles.body:
Three people have been arrested after a multi-vehicle crash on the A8 near Edinburgh Airport on Monday in which a woman died.

Police said two women, aged 23 and 19, and a 32-year-old man were arrested in connection with the crash, which happened at around 09:25 near Newbridge.

Officers previously said they were trying to trace the occupants of a grey Mercedes A250 who had left the scene of the collision on foot.

A 58-year-old woman, who was driving a Hyundai i30 was pronounced dead at the scene. Four other people were taken to hospital but later released.

Four vehicles in total were involved in the crash including a grey Skoda Karoq and a Renault Captur which could be seen flipped onto its roof.

The road was closed for a number of hours to allow an investigation to take place but reopened at 19:05.

Sgt Mike Thomson said: "Our thoughts remain with the family of the woman who died.

"Inquiries are ongoing to establish the full circumstances."

Residents living close to the scene of the crash described the chaotic scenes in the aftermath of the incident.

Tom Brumfitt, 69, who lives in one of the small row of cottages by the side of the road, said he heard "loud bangs" as he lay in bed when the collision happened.

He said: "It was just mayhem. It was the worst scenario I had seen outside for a long time.

"There was an almighty bang, a van partly on its side and then someone running past shouting 'help, help, help'."

Another resident, Paul Dow said he was in his house working when he heard "several large crashes and bangs".

He said he opened his front door to see smashed vehicles scattered across the eastbound and westbound carriageways.

articles.title: Renoir paintings theft 'shows museums should rethink security'
articles.summary: The founder of Art for Guernsey says more and more people consider artworks for their price.
articles.body:
A Guernsey art gallery says smaller museums should have tighter security measures after paintings by 19th Century painter Renoir were stolen in France.

Two thieves broke into the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer on Tuesday and walked out with four items worth more than 9m euros (£7.7m) each, before two were abandoned and recovered by authorities.

David Ummels, from Art for Guernsey, who was instrumental in bringing an exhibition of the impressionist's work to the island in 2023 , also said attitudes towards art had changed.

He said: "It's sad people are seeing artwork for their price rather than for the value that they've managed to create, and the way they have inspired communities."

Pierre-Auguste Renoir visited Guernsey in 1883 and during his month-long visit is thought to have created 15 paintings.

Some of those works were displayed on the island in 2023 thanks to provisions by private collectors and galleries across the world.

Ummels said that, unlike bigger territories, Guernsey's security was "ideally positioned" to protect artwork.

But he added it had become very difficult to balance security with letting people enjoy the paintings.

"My philosophy when we have people visiting a show is always to keep security measures to a minimum, but you have to protect the artworks against a moment of craziness.

"But this [theft] shows perfectly that smaller museums are really struggling because they have treasures and legacy, but they have less budget than the big museums.

"So they have to live with like suboptimal security systems.

"And so there is probably a big rethinking that needs to be done in the big countries on how they manage the security of the smaller museums."

Ummels arrived on the island 11 years ago and said he "fell in love" with Guernsey's "incredible integrity", and viewed it as something worth preserving.

"It's important to pass on the heritage and legacy, but also to inspire the youth, and to give them bravery.

"We have community spirit, the kindness, and it is very fortunate that things like [the theft] tend not to happen in Guernsey."

articles.title: Don't Look Back In Anger: Oasis' Cardiff comeback gig emotional, directors say
articles.summary: Filmmakers describe the gig as a "hugely emotional" experience that took Noel Gallagher by surprise.
articles.body:
Oasis' reunion gig at Cardiff's Principality Stadium was a "hugely emotional" experience that took Noel Gallagher by surprise, the directors of a film charting the brothers' comeback tour have said.

Will Lovelace and Dylan Southern's portrayal of the band's world tour in 2025 also captured the moment Liam and Noel reunited in the rehearsal studios following a 15-year hiatus.

Reflecting on the opening gig, Southern said: "You saw grown men who probably rarely express their emotions crying and hugging each other.

"Noel says in the film that he completely underestimated what it would be like, and it really did kind of hit him hard."

Lovelace said: "Those opening few moments, just as they're about to go on stage in Cardiff, and then the first song, was definitely a turning point on the tour but certainly in the film."

The directors told Behnaz Akhgar on BBC Radio Wales how the brothers' relationship grew as the tour progressed.

The film , Don't Look Back In Anger, shows that Columbia was the first song they practised during the reunion rehearsal.

Under Noel's instruction, the band had been piecing together the setlist before Liam's arrival.

"There was no kind of big entrance," said Lovelace.

"He walked in and said ''should we do this then?' and then [the band went] straight into a two-hour set."

Southern explained that the brothers "were that estranged that Noel's youngest sons and Liam's sons hadn't met".

"They were on tour for the whole time and they became like friends and more importantly family," he said.

"I think that was another huge thing in those barriers coming down between Liam and Noel was that suddenly there's this togetherness and harmony."

But it was the Cardiff gig that showed the kind of reception the band could expect to receive from fans old and new as they went back on the road.

"The sense of anticipation was huge," recalled Southern.

He said Noel "wasn't expecting... the emotional response" from fans.

"Looking out at the crowd and seeing three generations of a family out there, and not just fans from back in the day."

He added: "I'll never have another experience in my life like the one that we had in Cardiff. It was amazing."

Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger is in cinemas from Wednesday 9 September.

articles.title: Fourteen go on trial over deadliest Channel small boats disaster
articles.summary: At least 30 men, women and children drowned when their dinghy capsized on 24 November 2021.
articles.body:
Fourteen suspected people smugglers have gone on trial in Paris for their role in the worst ever small boats disaster in the English Channel.

In November 2021, at least 30 men, women and children drowned when their motorised dinghy deflated and started taking on water halfway between France and the UK.

The 14 defendants – mainly Afghan nationals – are accused of manslaughter and facilitating illegal immigration as part of an organised criminal group.

Most of them deny the charges. Two of the 14, who are alleged to be leaders of the operation, remain on the run and are being tried in absentia.

The boat left the French coast on the evening of 23 November 2021, but ran into difficulty in the middle of the Channel.

One by one the occupants entered the water to try to lessen the weight, but succumbed to the cold and drowned. Only two men survived.

According to the charge sheet, the defendants helped to launch "a small boat of poor quality, unfit to navigate at sea, overloaded and equipped with inadequate life-jackets".

Twenty-seven bodies were found after the boat sank, and another four were confirmed missing.

Many of the people who died were Iraqi Kurds, but others came from Somalia, Ethiopia, Egypt and Afghanistan. The youngest named victim was seven years old.

Some family members travelled to Paris for the start of the trial, which is expected to last three weeks.

"Once again [the smugglers displayed] total cynicism. Migrants are not sailors," said Emmanuel Daoud, a lawyer representing many of the families.

"The smugglers know perfectly well what they are doing. They take the deliberate, conscious risk of sending migrants to their deaths."

The defendants are accused of helping to organise the ill-fated journey by lodging and transporting the migrants, supplying the boat they left in, and handling the money they paid.

But many of them insist that they were themselves migrants and that if they were involved it was only under instructions from the real organisers.

The disaster led to enquiries on both sides of the Channel, with questions asked about the failure of British and French boats to rescue the people who died despite repeated calls from the floundering dinghy.

In France, seven military personnel – staff at a maritime rescue centre and on board a navy boat - are under judicial investigation on a possible charge of failing to assist persons in danger.

A judge will decide whether they should stand trial.

A UK inquiry found that HM Coastguard in Dover had limited capacity due to chronic staff shortages, while a surveillance aircraft was not launched due to poor weather conditions.

It also found that there was a widely held belief that migrants calling from small boats exaggerated the distress, meaning the coastguard underestimated the emergency.

articles.title: Nicaragua urges ICJ to reject Germany’s bid to throw out Gaza genocide case
articles.summary: Nicaragua maintains that German arms exports to Israel facilitated Gaza genocide as Germany’s tries to halt the case.
articles.body:
Nicaragua has urged the International Court of Justice (ICJ) to allow its case against Germany to continue, saying its arms exports to Israel violate the 1948 Genocide Convention and humanitarian law, as they were used in the genocidal war on Gaza.

The appeal came on Tuesday as public hearings on the preliminary objections raised by Germany took place in The Hague. Germany told the court on Monday that the case was improperly filed and should be thrown out.

“Nicaragua’s conduct indicates that it was not interested in hearing Germany’s view on its allegations, but simply in bringing Germany before this court,” Julia Monar, Germany’s top lawyer, told the judges.

Countries are typically expected to attempt to resolve disputes before bringing them to the court.

Lawyers for Nicaragua denied this, pointing to documents sent to the German foreign ministry as well as press releases describing the dispute.

Two years have passed since Nicaragua filed the case against Germany for “facilitating” the genocide in Gaza. Germany is the second-largest supplier of arms to Israel after the United States.

Nicaragua’s top lawyer, Carlos Jose Arguello Gomez, told the court that “it is impossible” Germany was not aware of the “serious risk that acts that could amount to genocide were being committed by Israel”.

Germany suspended all military exports to Israel in August last year, but resumed a few months later, referencing the stability of the ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas. Israel continued daily deadly attacks on Gaza immediately following the ceasefire.

Nicaragua says that German arms sales went up significantly after the beginning of the war on Gaza on October 7, 2023. Court documents show that export licenses worth $378m were issued in the last three months of 2023 compared to $45m in the first three months.

In April 2024, a German lawyer told the ICJ that 98 percent of arms exports to Israel since October 2023 were general equipment like vests, helmets and binoculars.

Nicaragua’s case against Germany builds on South Africa’s ongoing genocide case against Israel. In an interim ruling , the ICJ said it was plausible Israel violated some rights ‌guaranteed under the Genocide Convention.

Nicaragua and Germany are both signatories of the Genocide Convention, which includes an obligation on states to act to prevent possible genocide – but it is unusual for the court to hear cases where neither party is directly involved in the conflict at the heart of it.

A ruling on Germany’s objection ‌to ‌jurisdiction is expected later this year. If the ICJ rejects Germany’s bid, it can take until 2030 before a judgement is delivered.

articles.title: Photos: Palestinians rebuild Gaza’s ruins with mud bricks, scrap
articles.summary: Over 90 percent of Gaza lies in ruins, forcing thousands to rebuild homes with limited resources like mud and rubble.
articles.body:
Palestinians in Gaza are turning to mud bricks, salvaged wood, and sheets of fabric and plastic to rebuild homes and shops shattered by Israel’s genocidal war on the enclave.

Across neighbourhoods flattened by months of bombardment, families stack handmade bricks directly atop broken concrete, improvising fragile walls over cratered floors.

The rudimentary structures offer little protection from heat, rain, or cold, but residents say they are the only alternative to sleeping in overcrowded tents or in the open air.

Gaza authorities say more than 90 percent of the Strip has been destroyed since October 2023, leaving much of the Gaza Strip without adequate housing or basic infrastructure.

Israel has killed at least 73,658 Palestinians , including more than 21,500 children, according to Palestinian health authorities and Gaza’s Government Media Office.

The office estimates that Israel has dropped about 223,000 tonnes of explosives on the territory, generating about 68 million tonnes of rubble.

The United Nations says only about 310,000 tonnes – less than 0.5 percent – have so far been cleared, a pace that would take more than a century to remove the debris that now underpins Gaza’s fragile, handmade homes.
